history.round: R06, concurrency defect found and fixed: the battery keeps its probe tree under a per-process scratch directory, so two runs in the same working tree stop deleting each other's files mid-battery; one assertion added to pin that property
history.note: this pin was computed by category (222 + 1) and verified by two simultaneous full runs, both green - the pair of runs is itself the regression test for the collision

voidProbes.note: void means the default rule itself does not fire, so nothing can be said about the exception for that probe; void probes are printed as NOTE and excluded from per-probe assertions, which is exactly how a battery shrinks silently - the pin is what makes that loud

concurrencyDefect.symptom: two full-battery runs started in the same working tree reported 170/221 PASS with void probes and false failures, because the scratch path was a constant and the second run's rmtree wiped the first run's probe files mid-battery
concurrencyDefect.howItWasMistakenFor: a real gate failure - it reddened the mandatory matrix twice before the cause was identified
concurrencyDefect.regression: one assertion pins the process-scoped name, and two simultaneous runs of the delivered battery both exit 0 with 223 PASS / 0 FAIL / 0 NOTE
concurrencyDefect.tradeoffLeftOpen: a crashed run now leaves its own directory under the gitignored .work tree; nothing sweeps the prefix, because sweeping would re-open the race
